_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: A voice front end for Even Realities G2 glasses, pointed at the AI you run.

ask.text: Long-press the G2 touchbar to ask. The answer streams onto the glasses display.

phone.text: On the phone you see the exchange. The answer mirrors into a preview of the glasses display.

backends.text: Sign in with your Companion Intelligence account, or bring your own endpoint. Your prompts go only to the backend you configure.

approve.text: Coding agents can ask before they act. A double-tap approves, and a single tap denies.

close.text: Ask from your glasses with CI Companion. Visit e r dot ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
